original_test_intent: Verify the approved DUT-to-peer path supports MTU 1501, 5000 and 9000, sustaining a five-minute bandwidth run at each value without disconnect or new CRC/error evidence.
original_method: Configure both endpoints and path for each MTU in sequence, verify reachability, run a tracked five-minute iperf profile, compare complete before/after counters and logs, then restore the known-good MTU.
manual_activity: User approves dedicated DUT/peer/path, all MTUs, traffic and error thresholds and rollback; agent may run only the tracked bounded phases.
required_inputs: Exact DUT/peer interfaces, addresses/routes and intervening switch/path
Approved iperf version, direction, streams/rate and five-minute duration
No-disconnect, throughput/retransmit and CRC/error delta thresholds
Known-good MTU, independent management, rollback/recovery and protected evidence
safety_requirements: Exclude management/production paths and validate peer/switch support before change
Capture full baseline counters and change both endpoints in coordinated order
Stop on disconnect, access loss, counter/error growth, congestion or health issue
Track only launched iperf processes and preserve complete output
Restore both endpoints/path to known-good MTU; no LINK_TYPE change, reboot or auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect baseline and validate approved MTU/path matrix
Apply each MTU and run exactly five-minute tracked iperf with complete evidence
Compare counter deltas and restore known-good state
Do not change link type, guess thresholds, broad-kill, retry automatically or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve path, tool/workload, thresholds and rollback
Resolve any unsupported MTU or switch limitation
Review three-phase evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete and partly out of scope: only 9000 is applied, counters are filtered, peer/iperf phases are absent and LINK_TYPE/mlxconfig/reboot is not authorized by the Master.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: For each of 1501, 5000 and 9000 configure the approved path endpoints, verify route/link, run tracked five-minute iperf and collect full counter/log deltas before restoration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All three MTUs, five minutes each, iperf continuity, CRC check and 30/30 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a reversible three-phase MTU matrix with both-endpoint coordination, bounded traffic and complete delta evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds peer/path validation, exact workload, delta thresholds, process tracking and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents an MTU-9000-only result or duplicate-code row from replacing 1501/5000/9000 coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Path MTU mismatch may cause drops without CRC increments; reachability, iperf and interface counters must be interpreted together.

project_override_considerations: Do not merge with row440; project must keep the row68 Jumbo Frame and row440 Ethernet-mode bandwidth identities separate.
expected_evidence: Complete five-minute sender/receiver iperf output per MTU
Before/after CRC/error/retransmit/log deltas and disconnect record
Restored MTU/path health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master clearly defines the three MTUs and criteria; DeepSeek is incomplete and introduces irrelevant link-mode risk but does not override the authoritative source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Execution awaits normal project path and workload inputs; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Restores all three MTU phases and makes each five-minute traffic/counter result reversible and independently traceable.
independent_technical_reasoning: MTU success on the DUT alone does not prove end-to-end jumbo-frame support; peer and every intermediate hop must accept the frame size. CRC counters also capture physical corruption rather than all MTU drops, so bounded reachability, iperf continuity and full counter deltas are complementary evidence.
